title: Visual Naming Stimulus Manifest
notice: This manifest records provenance, licence claims, attribution requirements, and image modifications. It is not itself a licence grant.
modifications: Images may have been placed on a standardized background.
No authorship or endorsement by the original creators is implied.

boss.name: Bank of Standardized Stimuli (BOSS)
boss.publicationTitle: The Bank of Standardized Stimuli (BOSS), a New Set of 480 Normative Photos of Objects to Be Used as Visual Stimuli in Cognitive Research
boss.licenceNote: CC BY-SA 3.0 is reported by independent stimulus catalogues that identify the BOSS set and link to the former author-maintained project site. The public BOSS archive and original publication do not expose an accessible image-level licence statement in the sources checked on 2026-08-10. Retain the cited corroborating evidence and obtain an archived author-site licence statement or rightsholder confirmation for primary clearance.
